expectedIssues: Orders icon is missing from the bottom nav bar
reportedIssues: The second 'Popular right now' card (the −20% pizza) is cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar, so its name, rating and delivery info are not visible and the image appears abruptly sliced.

The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use inconsistent styles: the first is a dark heart on a white circle, the second is a white heart on a dark translucent circle, which looks like a rendering/state error and reduces contrast.
The third card title in 'Fastest near you' reads 'Trattoria Piccol' — clipped at the viewport edge with no ellipsis, so it looks broken rather than intentionally truncated.

The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light gray background while the sibling thumbnails are dark, making it look like a missing/placeholder image. Its time badge also has weaker contrast against the light background.
The category chip row is clipped mid-chip at the right edge with no visible affordance that it scrolls horizontally.
